name: Executive Dashboard
rows: Portfolio status as of 2025-06-30; percentages are weighted/aggregated as described below
• Credit deterioration is the clearest adverse signal: nonaccrual assets rose to 0.353% and net charge-offs to 0.478%; both are above June 2024 and March 2022.
• ROA recovered to 0.762% in 2Q25 from 0.657% a year earlier, but remains below 0.809% at the start. Margin recovery supports repricing/deposit-cost relief, while persistent weak earners remain.
• Reported total RBC declined to 14.251% from 15.199% at the start. Coverage is incomplete, so equity/assets and institution-specific capital schedules are necessary cross-checks.
• Loans/deposits rose from 80.5% to 93.8%, evidencing tighter on-balance-sheet funding. The 2024 peak eased, but several institutions remain above 100%.
• Attribution indicates that persistent institutions—not sample entry/exit—explain most credit deterioration and the reported capital decline. Weight shifts partly softened the ROA decline.
